Keep only the fields an entry actually sets

Source: R/el_timeline.R
dot-el_timeline_items.Rd

A v-for binding reading a missing property gets undefined, which is what makes Element fall back to a prop's default. Filling the gaps with NA would send JSON null instead, and null is a value: an entry without placement then matched neither placement === 'top' nor 'bottom', so its timestamp rendered nowhere at all.

Usage

.el_timeline_items(items)

Arguments

items

A list of entries.

Value

The entries with unknown and empty fields dropped.
